about: 46 synthetic cases for the symptom-first expansion (ransomware route, account access, ambiguity, traps, injection attempts). Written on 27 Oct 2026 BEFORE any ransomware rule existed, by the same AI that then wrote the rules, so author bias is real: the cases reflect what that author thought of. English only except two deliberate non-English cases. 'expect' is the best route after the 70% confidence threshold ('clarify' = the one-question screen). 'also_ok' lists other outcomes that are arguably safe. Some cases are deliberately hard; misses are reported, not hidden. 'kind' groups cases for separate error reporting: ransom (a real ransomware story), weak (too little to be sure, so clarify is right), payment, mailbox, message, ordinary, trap (contains ransomware-like words but is NOT ransomware), mixed (ransomware AND a payment problem: the bank-first path must not be lost), hostile (instructions hidden in the story).
history: Sealed on 27 Oct 2026. Rules for ransomware_suspected are written using prep/ransomware-dev.json only. This file is scored ONCE after that, and never used to tune. If a rule is changed after looking at a miss here, this set becomes 'used' and a new sealed set is needed before the next accuracy claim.
